literal_gloss: I-read the Acts of-the Sixth Council, in sessions [lacuna], in which Sergius, Cyrus, Pyrrhus of-Constantinople were-anathematized, with whom Honorius of-Rome, Polychronius and others with them, having-dared to-say one will and one energy in Christ. And the dogma of-the truth they-confirmed.
lemmas: ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΚΤΗΣ ΣΥΝΟΔΟΥ (Acts of the Sixth Council)
source_text: Codex 19 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, p. 5; 2026-09-18 image n16)
